other_exits: Long position closed when BrakeExp buffer 3 (DnSignal) is non-zero (opposite signal) or when buffer 1 (DnTrend) is non-zero (trend reversal without fresh signal)
Short position closed when BrakeExp buffer 2 (UpSignal) is non-zero (opposite signal) or when buffer 0 (UpTrend) is non-zero (trend reversal without fresh signal)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: negative MM value = fixed lot size (abs value), positive MM value = deposit fraction/risk percent. Default -0.1 means 0.1 lots fixed

custom_logic_notes: BrakeExp is a 4-buffer custom indicator: buffer 0 = UpTrend, buffer 1 = DnTrend, buffer 2 = UpSignal (fresh buy signal), buffer 3 = DnSignal (fresh sell signal). Signal distinction: UpSignal/DnSignal represent fresh entry signals (non-zero on signal bar), while UpTrend/DnTrend represent ongoing trend state used only for exit logic. Entry signals are read from SignalBar index (default 1 = previous completed bar). The EA stores signal timestamps (UpSignalTime, DnSignalTime) passed to BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen functions from TradeAlgorithms.mqh for potential timed order placement. Recount mechanism re-evaluates signals on data failure or insufficient bars. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose are input booleans that gate whether the EA is allowed to open/close long/short positions respectively.
python_conversion_notes: The BrakeExp custom indicator must be ported to Python or reimplemented since it has no standard equivalent. The indicator parameters A=3, B=1 control its behavior but the algorithm is unknown without the indicator source. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose - these encapsulate order execution, money management (negative MM=fixed lots, positive=deposit fraction), SL/TP placement, and deviation handling. The conditional money management logic (negative=lot, positive=fraction) must be explicitly coded. No digit adjustment is performed in this EA - SL/TP values are passed as-is in points, so Python conversion must handle point-to-price conversion based on symbol digits. Signal logic uses 4 separate indicator buffers which is unusual - need to understand buffer semantics before porting.
